separation.rule: Version 4 is a separately registered authority-allocation study. It does not repair, reopen or pool measurements with Versions 1–3. The V3 sealed fixtures, which received no model generation in V3, are repurposed as the declared V4 sealed set only after this registration.

research_question: Can deterministic code own every safety decision while a small local model is restricted to explaining an immutable authority envelope, and does the model earn its storage, memory and latency cost relative to a deterministic template?
cost_policy: Only free GitHub-hosted standard Arm runners and open-source software. No paid compute, API, subscription or real device.

variants.name: constrained model explanation
variants.authority: code fixes three fields; model proposes explanation only
variants.purpose: measure raw explanation acceptance and cost

variants.name: verified hybrid
variants.authority: code fixes three fields; accepted model explanation or template fallback

evaluation.scope: Synthetic Setup Companion states only; no phone, ADB, installation, commitment activation or device-safety claim.
evaluation.development_rule: Implementation tests and prompt construction may use only the declared development fixtures. No V4 model output may be generated for sealed fixtures before the deterministic decider, template, constrained parser, fallback and mutation suite pass locally.
evaluation.sealed_rule: After the apparatus gate passes, run every variant unchanged on all twelve sealed fixtures exactly once. No prompt, parser, template, decision rule or threshold changes are permitted afterward.

metrics.human_boundary: No superiority claim about clarity, comprehension, trust or usefulness is permitted without a separately recorded blinded human evaluation.

decision_rules.architecture: H0 is safe enough for further study only if every hybrid output passes and every authority mutation is rejected; otherwise retain T0.
decision_rules.model_value: The local model is not justified by automatic evidence alone. M0 must achieve at least 80 percent raw sealed explanation acceptance and later beat T0 in a registered blinded comprehension study before the model can be preferred.
decision_rules.fallback: Any parse, evidence, contradiction, forbidden-claim or timeout failure selects the deterministic template without retry.
decision_rules.no_claim: V4 does not claim real-device safety, therapeutic benefit, universal Arm performance, human comprehension improvement or that language generation is necessary.
